require 'json'; require 'digest'; require 'open3'
def git(*a)
  out,err,status=Open3.capture3('git',*a)
  abort(err) unless status.success?
  out
end
abort('unstaged changes') unless git('diff','--name-only').empty?
files=git('ls-files','-z').split("\0").sort.to_h do |path|
  [path, File.symlink?(path) ? ['symlink',File.readlink(path)] : [File.size(path),Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest]]
end
pins={}
base='reports/physical_bridge_2026_09_05/governance_remediation_2026_10_16/'
%w[INPUTS.json EXECUTION_INPUTS.json].each do |name|
  JSON.parse(File.read(base+name)).fetch('source_files').each do |row|
    actual=Digest::SHA256.file(row.fetch('path')).hexdigest
    abort('original source pin changed') unless actual==row.fetch('sha256')
    pins[row.fetch('path')]=actual
  end
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate({'head'=>git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip,'files'=>files,'pins'=>pins,'index_sha256'=>Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(git('ls-files','--stage','-z'))})
